name: parallel
description: Two snapshot rounds S1 (initiator n1) and S2 (initiator n2) overlap. t1 is sent after n1 recorded S1 and is post-cut for S1's n1->n2 channel (the S1 marker sits ahead of t1 in the same FIFO outbox). For S2, n2 records local state before t1 but only closes the n1->n2 channel when n1's S2 marker arrives — which happens AFTER t1 — so S2 legitimately captures t1=12 on that channel. t2 is sent after n3 recorded S1 but while n3 is still recording S2 on n1->n3, so S2 captures exactly t2=5 there. The two rounds keep isolated local states (n1: 50 vs 33, n2: 40 vs 40, n3: 10 vs 10); S1 globals 100+0, S2 globals 83+17=100. Derivation in docs/SCENARIOS.md.

S2 marker: n3 records S2 local (g10,h0)=10, closes n2->n3 EMPTY for S2
